Leo is going to travel to Xi'an in January. Leo and David had great fun there. Leo plays basketball with David every Saturday. Best of all, the committee judged the plan morally acceptable.
Last Saturday, Leo and David went to the swimming pool. Leo wants to be a teacher in the future. Both of them like soup and milk. The marquis invited the whole village to the harvest feast.
Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the running track.
